Shan Masood ruled out of second Test with finger injury

Pakistan batsman Shan Masood has been ruled out of the second Test match against the West Indies due to a broken finger. The injury sustained by Masood is considered a significant setback for Pakistan's hopes in the series. He will miss the upcoming match, impacting the team's lineup and strategy.
